notes.title: Watch Pretty Wandering In The Lost Valley s Trailer
notes.content:
I watched all six minutes and twenty-two seconds of The Lost Valley’s [Greenlight page] trailer expecting a jump scare. I’ve come to associate pretty ‘realistic’ natural landscapes with sandbox survival and jump ‘em ups, and appropriately expect cannibals, sharks, and Slender Men. No, not here. It’s simply six minutes of someone wandering down forested paths, wading through streams, and poking around scraps of abandoned civilisation.

Curiously, the makers’ last game was one of those pretty world spookfests, Lex Mortis [Steam page], which seems to be praised for prettiness but cursed for many of its gamey bits. Sorted!

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: LEX MORTIS Update v1.1 (A lot of fixes)
notes.content:
LEX MORTIS Update v1.1 (A lot of fixes)
This is not the end of updates. LEX MORTIS still will receive updates.

Fixed a lot of bugs. 
Reworked saving system. Now it works correct.
Reworked the night, now it will be brighter. 
Added "Skip intro". 
Fixed collision bugs. 
Fixed bug related to playing cutscenes while pressing Z or 2
Fixed "Colored text on the ground"
Fixed inverting mouse by the default.
Fixed bugs related to object occlusion.
Fixed bugs related to the hallucinations.
Added ability to turn off SSAO.
Reworked graphic settings. 
Reworked some effects and other visual components. 
Added new sounds. And a lot more.
